top_comments.author: @prernaagrawal2231
top_comments.text: the playbooks point about guaranteed instruction following is real, most agent failures i see are drift over long tasks not the model being dumb. had the same problem on a multi-file refactor and ended up using zencoder since the verification gates between steps kept it from wandering off spec, curious how this handles that on bigger codebases.

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: Yeah that drift is the killer, not the model being dumb. OpenMonoAgent.ai uses verification gates between steps too, so it doesn’t wander off spec in big multi-file refactors. How did Zencoder hold up for you once the codebase got really big?
